---
title: "Token Locked"
sidebarTitle: "Token Locked (403)"
description: "The error returned when a token is locked by the platform due to a potential leak."
---

## Error response

**Status code:** `403`

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Token locked due to a potential leak. Please generate a new token to continue. If you need any assistance, please contact the team.",
    "type": "forbidden",
    "source": "system",
    "details": {
      "request_id": "2026061615330428374635",
      "note": "This error was generated by the system, not from any upstream provider."
    }
  }
}
```

This error is returned by the platform itself, not by an upstream model provider.

## Cause

Our platform detected that this token is at risk of having been leaked. Even if the token shows no abnormal usage, we lock it defensively for security reasons, to prevent potential losses.

## Impact

* Only the locked token is affected; it can no longer be used
* Your account and balance are not affected, and your other tokens keep working
* The lock is a safety measure and does not mean your account has violated any policy

## How to fix

1. Create a new API key in the [dashboard](https://poixe.com/dashboard)
2. Replace the old key in your applications with the new one
3. Delete the locked token

## Recommendations

* Check your [usage logs](/en/docs/dashboard/logs) for any requests you don't recognize
* Never put keys in public repositories, frontend code, or screenshots
* If you have any questions or notice suspicious calls, contact the team at any time and include the `request_id`
